subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】spring 春天; summer 夏天; autumn 秋天; winter 冬天; season 季节; which 哪一个; best 最; snow 雪; because 因为
【重点句型】Which season do you like best? 你最喜欢哪个季节？ I like ... 我喜欢…… Why? 为什么？ Because ... 因为…… I can ... 我能……
【A Let's talk】Mike: Which season do you like best? Wu Yifan: Spring. It's pretty. Mike: Why? Wu Yifan: Because I can fly kites. Mike: I like winter best. I can play in the snow.
【Read and write】There are four seasons in a year: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Spring is warm. Summer is hot. Autumn is cool. Winter is cold. I like autumn best, because I can pick apples. My friend likes summer, because he can swim.
key_points: Which season do you like best? 你最喜欢哪个季节？
